records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Willow Dynamics!
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

Three outbound emails (email:bbb43522, email:9280717d, email:e006cab2) with zero customer reply and no tickets suggests disengagement; 8 days left makes unaided activation unlikely, though Pro plan and active subscription leave some intent.

draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project started
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

I know a new tool can be easy to put off in a busy week, so I'll keep this short.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually all it takes for things to click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I can walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
